ocr.notes: Gist readable; many character errors from the column rule running through the text (e.g. 'thirty seconds' read as 'egpek 4 seconds', '24 foot' as '44 foot').

title.suggested: Tom Allen among those favoring Kilrain over Sullivan under prize-ring rules

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat explained the differences between Queensberry and London prize-ring rules and said local authorities such as Bob Farrell and Tom Allen thought Kilrain could beat Sullivan under prize-ring rules.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, December 22, 1887, page 8.

notes: Allen is named only once, as one of several local authorities; no biographical facts.
